findings.title: Optimized paginator cannot paginate datetime fields
findings.body: This paginator is selected by the audit-log endpoint with `order_by="-datetime"`, but its key handling is copied from the numeric `Paginator`: `math.floor()`/`math.ceil()` cannot accept a `datetime`. On the first non-empty page, `build_cursor()` calls this method and raises `TypeError`, so requests using optimized pagination fail instead of returning audit logs. It also needs the datetime-to-cursor conversion and reverse conversion used by `DateTimePaginator`.

findings.title: Negative cursor offsets still raise on QuerySet slicing
findings.body: This branch passes a negative start index to a Django `QuerySet` slice. Django does not support negative QuerySet indices and raises `ValueError` (“Negative indexing is not supported”), so an optimized-pagination request with a negative cursor offset produces an error rather than supporting the advertised reverse pagination. `Cursor.from_string()` accepts negative offsets, making this reachable with a cursor supplied by the client.
